PDF Real-time Voxelization for Complex Models - GitHub Pages
This paper describes a novel real-time voxelization approach for polygonal surfaces as well as solid and multi-valued voxelization. We decompose the task into three stages, namely, rasterization, texelization and synthesis which are accomplished entirely in GPU (graphics processing units).
